title: How Bonding Curve Token Economics Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Curve["Bonding Curve Phase"]
        B["Buyer deposits reserve"] --> M["Contract mints tokens"]
        M --> UP["Supply up, price up"]
        S["Seller redeems tokens"] --> BR["Contract burns tokens"]
        BR --> DN["Supply down, price down"]
        UP --> P["price = f(supply)"]
        DN --> P
    end
    P --> R["Reserve grows on-chain"]
    R --> G{"Curve target reached?"}
    G -->|No| B
    G -->|Yes| GRAD["graduateToken()"]
    GRAD --> POOL["Seed DEX AMM pool"]
    POOL --> OPEN["Open-market trading"]

title: Attack Vector
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A["Attacker"] --> CH{"Choose attack seam"}
    subgraph V1["V1: Supply manipulation (Eminence)"]
        FL["Flash-borrow reserve"] --> MINT["Mint large supply slug"]
        MINT --> WALK["Burn to walk price"]
        WALK --> REDEEM["Redeem rest at dislocated price"]
    end
    subgraph V2["V2: Graduation (Moonbound)"]
        PRE["Pre-create DEX pair"] --> SEED["Seed 1e10 vs 1 wei"]
        SEED --> RATIO["amountMin = 0 forces bad ratio"]
        RATIO --> DRAIN["Swap to drain pool"]
    end
    subgraph V3["V3: Graduation DoS"]
        FORCE["selfdestruct sends extra KAS"] --> REVERT["addLiquidity reverts"]
        SELL1["Sell 1 wei at boundary"] --> STALL["totalSold below threshold"]
    end
    subgraph V4["V4: Sandwich"]
        FRONT["Buy ahead of victim"] --> VPUSH["Victim pushes price up"]
        VPUSH --> BACK["Sell behind victim"]
    end
    CH --> FL
    CH --> PRE
    CH --> FORCE
    CH --> FRONT
    REDEEM --> PROFIT["Profit extracted"]
    DRAIN --> PROFIT
    BACK --> PROFIT
    REVERT --> BLOCK["Launch permanently blocked"]
    STALL --> BLOCK

title: Defense Pattern
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    T["Curve buy / sell / graduate"] --> AUTH{"Edition / params verified?"}
    AUTH -->|No| REJ["Revert: unregistered curve"]
    AUTH -->|Yes| FLASH{"Same-block mint and burn?"}
    FLASH -->|Yes| REJ2["Block: enforce 1-block freeze"]
    FLASH -->|No| GRADCHK
    subgraph Graduation["Harden graduation"]
        GRADCHK["Set amountTokenMin / amountKASMin"] --> NOPRE["Forbid early pair creation"]
        NOPRE --> TRACK["Track reserve via internal counter"]
        TRACK --> RANGE["Trigger on range, not strict equality"]
        RANGE --> MINSELL["Enforce minimum sell size"]
    end
    MINSELL --> SLIP{"Slippage and TWAP checks pass?"}
    SLIP -->|No| REJ3["Revert: price out of bounds"]
    SLIP -->|Yes| OK["Execute trade / seed pool"]
